== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[A Jedi's Fury (Errata)]]: the region (108, 700, 724, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[A Jedi's Fury (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif Holotable commit e02f932] (2026-03-07). The matching before crop is [[:File:V21-L-ajedisfury-2026-03-07-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[A Jedi's Fury]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif commit efc26cd]) and [[A Jedi's Fury (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif commit e02f932]).
